I'm getting into robotics.

I'm working on using one Pi to control the "head" with 2 16x2 LCDs, audio output (talking), and hopefully a few head servos.

A second Pi controls the servos for the "arm" and motor for wheels.

I want to step it up a notch and make it a quadruped. That'll require a few more servo hats and a lot more servos. Might be easier to use a third Pi to control the legs at that point.

Most of this is still in bits and pieces and not assembled yet. If it ever gets to a point where its not embarrassing I'll share.
